featured_reviews.name: Note from Travelam
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visiting the Mumbai Dabbawala collection point near the railway station was one of the most fascinating experiences of my Mumbai trip. Watching thousands of lunch boxes being sorted, grouped, and dispatched with remarkable precision was truly impressive.

Our guide explained the entire system in detail, from the collection of home-cooked meals to the complex sorting process and their timely delivery across the city. What amazed me most was how this world-famous network operates with such efficiency, accuracy, and coordination, largely without the use of advanced technology.

The dedication, discipline, and teamwork of the Dabbawalas are inspiring. Seeing this unique logistics system in action gave me a whole new appreciation for the people who keep Mumbai moving every day. A highly recommended experience for anyone visiting Mumbai and wanting to understand the city’s incredible work culture and spirit.

featured_reviews.review_text:
The Dabba from Ghar Cha Dabba was tasty and cooked very well!
Nothing too oily, not too spicy. Truly healthy and home cooked food :)
Definitely will order again!

featured_reviews.name: Riddhi Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ghar cha dabba is one of the best places to order homemade food.
They have a lot of vegetarian options in breakfast and lunch ranging from traditional marathi nashta and bhaji, Punjabi style sabji to rice combo options. Methi malai matar and shevaiyya kheer is my ultimate favourite!
They also have lip smacking High-tea variety. Along with the food, the packaging is also great!! Highly recommended :)

featured_reviews.name: Akshay Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text: Very tasty, quality food and very well packaged. Loved all the variety of dishes. Must try!

featured_reviews.name: Shardul Parab
featured_reviews.review_text: Amazing food. Not only is it delicious but also healthy. Absolute delight!

featured_reviews.name: alok kakatkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Delicious food and on time delivery. 100% recommended.
